flow: ui-path (ChatDriver) — composer insertText + Enter, streamed answer (Centrifuge WS turn events with seq-paginated REST fallback)

steps.note: session snapshot injected (data/app.innerai.com/.session); may redirect to https://platform.innerai.com/login.html when anonymous — complete email+password (or social) once, then continue. Selectors UNVERIFIED (hashed CSS-modules SPA)

rpc: underlying wire = v3 agentic chat: POST https://platformapi.innerai.com/api/v1/chat/messages {session_id, message, document_ids?, metadata{capability_hint?}} -> {turn_id, assistant_message_id}; realtime = Centrifuge WS wss://chat-api-v3-ws.innerai.com/connection/websocket using connection_token + subscription_token from POST /api/v1/realtime/tokens {session_id}; turn events REST fallback GET /api/v1/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/turns/{turn_id}/events (since_seq, limit). Auth = USER-EMAIL/USER-TOKEN/DEVICE-ID headers from cookies token/email/deviceId. The UI path drives the site's own JS so no channel names / protobuf reconstruction needed.
stealth: real session, trusted inputs, site's own send handler — indistinguishable from the user typing
